Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of gathered data regarding the specific field of recognition associated with each filmmaker. The Planner incorrectly concluded that Pamela B. Green is the answer based on the presence of "motion graphics" in her search results, failing to distinguish between general motion graphics work (which she does) and being "known for animation" as a primary identity (which Lev Yilmaz is, specifically for the animated comic series "Tales of Mere Existence"). The Planner failed to prioritize the explicit "animator" label found for Lev Yilmaz over the broader "motion graphics" descriptor for Green, leading to the selection of the wrong candidate.
